notes.subject: 2027 outreach timing reviewed
notes.body: Wells County Fair ran June 18-21, 2026. Its official site includes vendor information, but no official 2027 dates or application opening were published when reviewed on August 30, 2026. A personalized Adventure Zone email is prepared for Mary Hartl but must be reviewed before sending.
